correctness.rationale: For any split basic finite-dimensional K algebra, explicit joint idempotents p_a from a commuting tuple lift the coloring projections E_a, and u=sum_a p_a E_a lies in 1+J, conjugating the full tuple. Stabilizer is exactly 1+oplus_{c(i)=c(j)} e_iJe_j; orbit-stabilizer gives q^{sum_{i<j}w_ij [c_i != c_j]} for each coloring. Surjection/Stirling inversion yields every distinct-idempotent clique count. All commuting families extend to a maximal Boolean family of size 2^n; conjugation gives q^{sum w_ij} such families. The two 6D quiver algebras have equal Peirce w and different J^2. Independently evaluated three-color sums at q=2,3, arity 0..3 to (1,26,340,3368) and (1,56,976,10592). The orbit proof, not finite checks, covers all q,n,k.
